# go-lisp (.lgo) files are Go source files for the go command:
# they are listed, built, run, and tested like .go files.

go list -f '{{.GoFiles}} {{.Imports}}' .
stdout '^\[helper.go main.lgo\] \[example.com/demo/emb example.com/demo/geom fmt\]$'
go list -f '{{.GoFiles}} {{.IgnoredGoFiles}} {{.TestGoFiles}} {{.XTestGoFiles}}' ./geom
stdout '^\[geom.lgo\] \[ignored.lgo\] \[geom_test.lgo\] \[x_test.lgo\]$'
go list -f '{{.GoFiles}} {{.IgnoredGoFiles}} {{.EmbedPatterns}}' ./emb
[GOOS:linux] stdout '^\[emb.lgo emb_linux.lgo\] \[emb_windows.lgo\] \[hello.txt\]$'
stdout ' \[hello.txt\]$'

go build -o demo$GOEXE .
exec ./demo$GOEXE
stdout '^area: 12 embedded hi$'

go run .
stdout '^area: 12 embedded hi$'

# named files
go run main.lgo helper.go
stdout '^area: 12 embedded hi$'

# tests in go-lisp, in the package and in an external test package
go test -v ./geom
stdout '^--- PASS: TestTotal'
stdout '^--- PASS: TestCircle'

# vet does not read go-lisp files; packages with them are not vetted
go vet ./...

# compile errors point into the go-lisp source
! go build ./bad
stderr 'bad[/\\]bad.lgo:4:'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/demo

go 1.28
-- main.lgo --
(package main)

(import "fmt" "example.com/demo/geom" "example.com/demo/emb")

(func main [] []
  (fmt.println (greeting) (geom.total (:lit geom.rect (:kv :w 3) (:kv :h 4))) emb.message))
-- helper.go --
package main

func Greeting() string { return "area:" }
-- geom/geom.lgo --
;go:build !never

(package geom)

(import "math")

(type shape (interface (area [] [float64])))
(type rect (struct [w h float64]))
(type circle (struct [r float64]))

(func [-r rect] area [] [float64] (return (* -r.w -r.h)))
(func [-c circle] area [] [float64] (return (* math.Pi -c.r -c.r)))

(func total [-shapes (... shape)] [float64]
  (var -sum float64)
  (for [_ -s (range -shapes)]
    (+= -sum (-s.area)))
  (return -sum))
-- geom/ignored.lgo --
;go:build never

(package geom)

(this is not valid)
-- geom/geom_test.lgo --
(package geom)

(import "testing")

(func test-total [-t (* testing.T)] []
  (if (!= (total (:lit rect (:kv :w 2) (:kv :h 3)) (:lit rect (:kv :w 1) (:kv :h 1))) 7)
    (-t.error "wrong total")))
-- geom/x_test.lgo --
(package geom_test)

(import "testing" "example.com/demo/geom")

(func test-circle [-t (* testing.t)] []
  (if (< (geom.total (:lit geom.circle (:kv :r 1))) 3.14)
    (-t.error "too small")))
-- emb/emb.lgo --
(package emb)

(import [_ "embed"])

;go:embed hello.txt
(var message string)
-- emb/hello.txt --
embedded hi
-- emb/emb_linux.lgo --
(package emb)
-- emb/emb_windows.lgo --
(package emb)
-- bad/bad.lgo --
(package bad)

(func f [] [int]
  (return "not an int"))
